// PROBE: a compliant surface, deliberately full of near-miss shapes the scanner
// must NOT flag:
//   - status literals in COMPARISONS (=== / case), never produced
//   - a ternary whose else-branch starts the next line with `:` after `copy.expired`
//   - Tailwind's `active:` variant inside a className string
//   - calendarDaysUntil used for a COUNTDOWN, with no status literal produced
//   - this comment block itself, which names return 'expired' and
//     status: 'action_needed' — mentions in prose must not trip the matcher
import { getPolicyStatusView } from '@/lib/wallet/policy-status-view'
import { calendarDaysUntil } from '@/lib/policy-status'

export function CompliantCard({ policy, t, copy }: any) {
    const view = getPolicyStatusView(policy, t)
    const headline =
        view.key === 'expired' ? copy.expired
            : view.key === 'expiring_soon' ? copy.expiringSoon
                : copy.everythingFine

    switch (view.key) {
        case 'expired':
            break
        default:
            break
    }

    const daysLeft = view.endDate ? calendarDaysUntil(view.endDate, new Date()) : null

    return (
        <button className="rounded-full active:scale-95 hover:bg-primary">
            {headline} {daysLeft}
        </button>
    )
}
